Title: Fix CurStepChanged CBackend collapse from ternary to binary
Description: In installer/SplitBrainAI.iss CurStepChanged, 'if RbOllama.Checked then CBackend := ollama else CBackend := llamacpp' overwrites the three-valued CBackend (llamacpp-native / llamacpp-docker) with a bare llamacpp string. IsLlamaCppNative() and IsLlamaCppDocker() both return False after this fires. Fix: use the same CaptureBackend pattern as CurPageChanged.
